q: The efficiencies of the steps of the energy chain of a power plant are $\eta_1 = 0.90$, $\eta_2 = 0.50$ and $\eta_3 = 0.96$. What is the efficiency of the whole chain?
a: The efficiencies are multiplied: $\eta = \eta_1 \eta_2 \eta_3 = 0.90 \cdot 0.50 \cdot 0.96 = 0.432 \approx 43\,\%$. They are not added or averaged.
